options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal Forms
options.doc:
How many different witch forms must clear the Nightmare Wedding boss, each a
separate winning run. Untransformed does not count.
options.doc_fr: Combien de formes de sorcières différentes doivent effacer le chef Nightmare Mariage, chacun une course gagnante séparée. Non transformé ne compte pas.

options.name: Shop Locations
options.doc:
How many locations the witch's shop stocks, in place of the upgrades.

Shelf *n* costs 4.5 Love Coins times *n*, up to 90 from the twentieth on.
options.doc_fr:
Combien d'emplacements les stocks de la boutique de sorcière, au lieu des améliorations.

Table *n* coûte 4.5 pièces d'amour fois *n*, jusqu'à 90 à partir du vingtième.

options.name: Potion Slot Locations
options.doc:
Make each of the three potions offered after a stage its own location, for 54 in
all. Off, the screen is one location whichever potion you take, for 18.
options.doc_fr: Faire de chacune des trois potions offertes après une étape son propre emplacement, pour 54 en tout. Off, l'écran est un endroit quel que soit la potion que vous prenez, pour 18.

options.name: Hard Upgrade Levels Required
options.doc:
Upgrade levels you must hold before Hard Wedding's potion and boss locations
count as reachable, on top of the Progressive Difficulty that opens it.

options.name: Nightmare Upgrade Levels Required
options.doc:
Upgrade levels you must hold before Nightmare Wedding's potion and boss locations
count as reachable, on top of both Progressive Difficulties. Raised to match Hard's
requirement if you set it lower.
